# Generates mean posterior predictions for objects fitted by [`bayesnec::bnec()`](https://open-aims.github.io/bayesnec/reference/bnec.html)

Generates mean posterior predictions for objects fitted by
[`bayesnec::bnec()`](https://open-aims.github.io/bayesnec/reference/bnec.html).
`object` should be of class
[bayesnec::bayesnecfit](https://open-aims.github.io/bayesnec/reference/bayesnecfit-class.html)
or
[bayesnec::bayesmanecfit](https://open-aims.github.io/bayesnec/reference/bayesmanecfit-class.html).

## Usage

``` r
# S3 method for class 'bayesnecfit'
predict(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'bayesmanecfit'
predict(object, summary = TRUE, robust = FALSE, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), ...)
```

## Arguments

- object:

  An object of class
  [bayesnec::bayesnecfit](https://open-aims.github.io/bayesnec/reference/bayesnecfit-class.html)
  or
  [bayesnec::bayesmanecfit](https://open-aims.github.io/bayesnec/reference/bayesmanecfit-class.html)
  returned by
  [`bayesnec::bnec()`](https://open-aims.github.io/bayesnec/reference/bnec.html).

- ...:

  Additional arguments to
  [`brms::predict.brmsfit()`](https://paulbuerkner.com/brms/reference/predict.brmsfit.html)
  if object is of class
  [bayesnec::bayesnecfit](https://open-aims.github.io/bayesnec/reference/bayesnecfit-class.html),
  or to
  [`brms::posterior_predict.brmsfit()`](https://paulbuerkner.com/brms/reference/posterior_predict.brmsfit.html)
  if object is of class
  [bayesnec::bayesmanecfit](https://open-aims.github.io/bayesnec/reference/bayesmanecfit-class.html).

- summary:

  Should summary statistics be returned instead of the raw values?
  Default is `TRUE`.

- robust:

  If `FALSE` (the default) the mean is used as the measure of central
  tendency and the standard deviation as the measure of variability. If
  `TRUE`, the median and the median absolute deviation (MAD) are applied
  instead. Only used if `summary` is `TRUE`.

- probs:

  The percentiles to be computed by the `quantile` function. Only used
  if `summary` is `TRUE`.

## Value

See
[`?brms::predict.brmsfit`](https://paulbuerkner.com/brms/reference/predict.brmsfit.html).

## Methods (by class)

- `predict(bayesnecfit)`: Method for a single-model fit of class
  [bayesnec::bayesnecfit](https://open-aims.github.io/bayesnec/reference/bayesnecfit-class.html).

- `predict(bayesmanecfit)`: Method for a model-averaged fit of class
  [bayesnec::bayesmanecfit](https://open-aims.github.io/bayesnec/reference/bayesmanecfit-class.html);
  returns summary statistics controlled by `summary`, `robust` and
  `probs`.

## Examples

``` r
# \donttest{
library(bayesnec)

# Uses default `resolution` and `x_range` to generate `newdata` internally
predict(manec_example)
```
